purpose: Turn 137 original R29 source-screened catalogue entries into a reproducible action/evidence queue; NOT legal compliance, finished product legal CTR article assignment or batch release.

source_priority_definitions.P0: 4 high-risk incorrect-article/source-recipe cases: cocoa beans, carob powder, Ayurveda recipes 14.6/14.7.
source_priority_definitions.P1: 12 FPC18 sweets/snacks direction source eligibility cases.
source_priority_definitions.P2: 70 conditional named source article cases requiring actual product legal adjudication.
source_priority_definitions.P3: 51 remaining product identity / FoSCoS classification / interim licensing / Ayurveda recipe cases.

all_cases.manufacturer: Actual manufacturer and SKU + full ingredient BOM, FSSR/FoSCoS classification, batch, processing, pack and label.
all_cases.regulatory: Current original Gazette/effective amendments, correct named/competing finished article, qualifiers, analytes/method, all applicable additives/micro/claim requirements.
all_cases.lab: Actual sample matrix/basis, validated methods including LOQ if relevant, lot-wise reports and independent regulatory QA signoff.

CONDITIONAL_CTR_SOURCE_CANDIDATE.next: Check current Gazette named CTR article, conflicting articles, actual SKU ingredients and method.

SOURCE_IDENTITY_STANDARD_NOT_CTR_DECISIO.next: Verify actual standardized SKU recipe/form and specific CTR commodity article; avoid name inheritance.

FOSCOS_CLASSIFICATION_ROUTE_NOT_CTR_DECI.next: Obtain real SKU formula/identity, FSSR category and legally applicable CTR article; FoSCoS alone is not numeric.

INTERIM_LICENSING_ROUTE_NOT_CTR_DECISION.next: Check current interim licensing validity plus formula, original Gazette and actual product CTR scope.

WRONG_ARTICLE_INHERITANCE_BLOCKED.next: Maintain cocoa-powder wrong-article block for cocoa beans/carob; verify legitimate raw/processed source.

AYURVEDA_CATEGORY_A_RECIPE_SOURCE_ANCHOR.next: Verify actual source recipe/variant, ingredient purity, Central licence, Schedule D and finished CTR panel.

CONDITIONAL_FPC18_DIRECTION.next: Verify FPC18 eligibility, 2021 direction, formula/base ingredients, Appendix B and current CTR panels.

source_data_limitation: No real SKU-specific formula, lot and validated laboratory reports embedded in this R29 audit source; a blank FCS/FSSR field in the source is NOT a legal exemption.
prohibition: No final legal PASS, numeric limit auto-apply, commercial release, or original Gazette/effective-date inference from source screening.
